environment: Neon TEST metadata only; no changes

checks.subject: flight_import_batches
checks.name: uq_committed_import_hash
checks.detail: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_committed_import_hash ON app.flight_import_batches USING btree (aircraft_id, source_file_sha256) WHERE (status = 'COMMITTED'::text)

checks.subject: flight_records
checks.name: uq_flight_import_row
checks.detail: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_flight_import_row ON app.flight_records USING btree (import_batch_id, import_row_number) WHERE (import_batch_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.subject: component_installations
checks.name: uq_open_component_installation
checks.detail: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_open_component_installation ON app.component_installations USING btree (component_id) WHERE (removed_on IS NULL)
